analysis.rationale: Revenue and profit more than doubled YoY, driven by capacity expansion and improved margins. Debt service coverage ratio improved dramatically, indicating strong operational turnaround.
analysis.summary: Auro Laboratories reported FY2025-26 revenue of Rs. 3073.98 lakhs (up 60.7% YoY) and net profit of Rs. 353.29 lakhs (up 92.1% YoY), with EPS of Rs. 5.67.
